body:
Model movements found the climbing branch's low end and a rock inside the half-log hide, so the coiled sleeping snake went through them.
Now (book v161): the branch is turned round, low end on the right, rising over the hide; the rock moved to the right front corner. The hide is empty.
Pick in Model Compare → Snake terrarium (🔔).
short: Check: the hide is empty for the sleeping snake
title: Snake terrarium: branch and rock out of the hide
